title: Active Directory attack-path chains (authorized internal)
detail: Authorized internal only. 1) **Recon/assets:** identify DCs, domain, trusts (DNS/LDAP/SMB/Kerberos), hosts/users/groups/SPNs, ACLs (netexec/ldapsearch/bloodhound-python where in-scope). 2) **Initial access/creds:** valid creds, ASREProast/Kerberoast candidates, shares, password policy — controlled, avoid lockout. 3) **Escalate/paths:** local privesc, delegation issues, ACL abuse paths, **ADCS** misconfig concepts (ESC paths) — validate with evidence in scope. 4) **Lateral/relay concepts:** SMB signing/relay conditions, coercion-prone services — test only authorized, non-destructive validation. 5) **Evidence→findings:** each step produces facts (cred/service/vuln) and confirmed findings with proof. Use ad-attack, ad-pki-certificate, credential-handling, lateral-movement, privilege-relay skills. No unauthorized changes.
